t: You're at the Blacker Dread Muzik Store, a record shop. It was founded and owned by Blacker Dread, who was also a soundsystem owner, and that pairing matters. Record shops and soundsystems go hand in hand: the shop supplies the music, and the soundsystem carries it out to the crowd. So this place is part of a wider sound culture, not just a counter with records on it. I don't have more detail than that, so I'll say no more.
